thread:
alex: Heads up — new tenant 'Orpheus' onboarding. They need APAC capacity in two regions (ap-northeast-3, ap-southeast-3). Asking for GPU quota increases (p5, p4d, g5) + ENI / EFA limits. AWS account: 987654321098.

tara: Got it. What's the target numbers and timeline?

alex: Target by EOW (10 business days). Proposed per-region increases: 
```
ap-northeast-3: p5.xlarge -> 6, p4d.24xlarge -> 4, g5.12xlarge -> 20
ap-southeast-3: p5.xlarge -> 2, p4d.24xlarge -> 2, g5.12xlarge -> 20
```
Also bump ENI limit to 300 and EFA-enabled instance quota to 20 in each region.

samir: Do we need launch-template permissions or placement group quotas too? Orpheus will run multi-AZ jobs that use placement groups.

alex: Yes — placement-group instances should be allowed. Also request ENI per AZ increase and ensure subnet ENI capacity — asked them to pre-provision ENIs in the onboarding VPC.

kelly: I opened an AWS Support case and a TAM callback. Case ID: 1234567890123. AWS TAM (Anand) said he'll prioritize p5/g5 capacity if we provide expected sustained vGPU count and cost commitment.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: new-support-case created: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1234567890123 :information_source:

tara: Can you paste the short justification I can forward to the TAM? Need to justify production SLA + reserved throughput.

alex: Sent justification to kelly but paste here: "Customer Orpheus is a commercial tenant onboarding for generative workloads. Expected steady-state: 10–15 concurrent p5 sessions (latency-critical), batch fine-tuning on 8x p4d instances, and embedding/ingest on up to 40 g5 GPUs. We require guaranteed capacity to meet SLA and reduce eviction risk. Willing to commit to a 3-month test run and provide forecasted usage numbers for reserved capacity if required."

samir: AWS asked for the specific instance family quotas separately for On-Demand and Spot. We should request: On-Demand p5: 8, p4d: 6, g5: 40; Spot limits can be higher but tag them as "best-effort".

kelly: Updated case with those numbers. Also requested ENI quotas: 300, EFA interfaces: 40, and Elastic IPs: 50 across the two regions. Link to case: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=1234567890123

alex: Note on costs — Orpheus will absorb overage for first 30 days, budget approved. Finance flagged we should track per-tenant GPU utilization closely. Add a per-tenant metric in Skyline for Orpheus usage.

tara: I'll create a Skyline dashboard tile and add alerts for sustained GPU <80% or >95% utilization.

aws-tam: Anand (AWS-TAM): Confirmed on TAM call: we've submitted a quota lift request to the regional team. ETA is 48–72 hours but p4d capacity allocations may take longer due to rack availability. Please supply exact AZ preferences and expected provisioning dates.

alex: AZ prefs: ap-northeast-3a primary, fallback ap-northeast-3c. ap-southeast-3a primary, fallback ap-southeast-3b. Provisioning window preferred: 7–10 days from now.

samir: Also double-check the ENI IP-per-host limits for the instance types — g5.12xlarge can run into VPC IP exhaustion if subnets are too small. We'll resize subnets where needed.

kelly: AWS case updated with AZs and subnet plan. They requested an IAM role for verification — created role arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/Redwood-Onboard-Verification and attached to the case.

infra-bot: reminder: run `aws ec2 describe-account-attributes --region ap-northeast-3` after quotas update to verify.

alex: Thanks. I'll follow up if they push back on p4d availability. If p4d is delayed, we want fallback to smaller p4 or additional g5s to cover throughput.

tara: Sync later today 4pm to confirm AWS updates. :calendar: :thumbsup:

kelly: Reaction :white_check_mark: — will post updates in this thread as the case moves.

alex: Closing loop — leaving notes for oncall: if provisioning fails, we'll triage with infra-ops and consider temporary Dedicated fallback.
